title: Twin Spires
description: A darker 150bpm UK bassline cut where syncopated 606 kicks weave around off-beat sawtooth chord stabs. It climbs to a first peak, sinks into a delay-soaked valley, then surges to a second, harder peak before stripping back to the bare groove.
code:
setcpm(150/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.05),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(500,900)).room(0.4).gain(0.42)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.1),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(700).gain(0.5),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(tri.slow(24).range(600,1500)).room(0.4).gain(0.46)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.1),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.6),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).degradeBy(0.15),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(600,1300)).gain(0.55),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(tri.slow(16).range(800,2000)).delay(".4:.1875:.4").room(0.35).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("~ sd ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.45),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(tri.slow(16).range(400,1100)).delay(".5:.25:.72").room(0.6).gain(0.48)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.15),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.62),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.6).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("oh ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.4),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(12).range(700,1700)).gain(0.58),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(900,2400)).delay(".4:.1875:.55").room(0.35).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.18),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.62),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.62).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("oh ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.42),
    note("<c2 g1 ab1 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(800,2000)).gain(0.6).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(tri.slow(12).range(1000,2600)).delay(".4:.1875:.6").room(0.4).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [14, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.05),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(14).range(900,400)).delay(".5:.25:.7").room(0.5).gain(0.44)
  )]
)
